Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Tharvai, District Prayagraj.

Further prayer has been made not to arrest the petitioner in the aforesaid case.
3.
Smt. Manju Thakur, learned A.G.A.-I states that in the present matter, chargesheet has already been submitted before the competent court.
As such, the cause of filing the writ petition no more survives and the writ petition is liable to be dismissed as infructuous.
4. In view of the above, the writ petition is dismissed as infructuous with liberty to the petitioner to apply for bail as permissible under law and in accordance with law.
